#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the "codbox" theme blocks (viridescent, solarized osaka, gruvbox dark,
watermelon) for editor/ColorConfig.ts.

Base palettes come from monkeytype (frontend/src/ts/constants/themes.ts):
  viridescent     bg #2c3333  caret #f0d3c9  main #95d5b2  sub #84a98c  text #e9f5db
  solarized_osaka bg #00141a  caret #b58900  main #859900  sub #2aa198  text #eee8d5
  gruvbox_dark    bg #282828  caret #fabd2f  main #d79921  sub #665c54  text #ebdbb2
  watermelon      bg #1f4437  caret #d6686f  main #d6686f  sub #3e7a65  text #cdc6bc

Channel colors follow the dark-theme convention used by the other themes in this
file: secondary channel = dark, primary channel = bright, secondary note = mid,
primary note = light.
"""

def hsl(h: float, s: float, l: float) -> str:
    h %= 360.0
    s /= 100.0
    l /= 100.0
    c = (1 - abs(2 * l - 1)) * s
    x = c * (1 - abs((h / 60.0) % 2 - 1))
    m = l - c / 2
    r, g, b = {
        0: (c, x, 0), 1: (x, c, 0), 2: (0, c, x), 3: (0, x, c),
        4: (x, 0, c), 5: (c, 0, x),
    }[int(h // 60) % 6]
    return "#%02x%02x%02x" % tuple(round((v + m) * 255) for v in (r, g, b))


# lightness ladder per channel kind, per theme (dark themes: channel bright > note light)
LADDER = (30, 66, 46, 80)  # sec-channel, prim-channel, sec-note, prim-note


def channel_block(prefix: str, slots, ladder=LADDER):
    sc, pc, sn, pn = ladder
    out = []
    for i, (h, s) in enumerate(slots, start=1):
        out.append(f"\t\t\t\t--{prefix}{i}-secondary-channel:  {hsl(h, s, sc)};")
        out.append(f"\t\t\t\t--{prefix}{i}-primary-channel:    {hsl(h, s, pc)};")
        out.append(f"\t\t\t\t--{prefix}{i}-secondary-note:     {hsl(h, s, sn)};")
        out.append(f"\t\t\t\t--{prefix}{i}-primary-note:       {hsl(h, s * 0.85, pn)};")
    return "\n".join(out)


def theme(name: str, comment: str, vars: dict, pitch, noise, mod, ladder=LADDER):
    lines = [f'\t\t"{name}": `', "\t\t\t:root {", f"\t\t\t\t/* {comment} */"]
    for k, v in vars.items():
        lines.append(f"\t\t\t\t--{k}: {v};")
    sc, pc, sn, pn = ladder
    lines.append(f"\t\t\t\t/* channel colors: dark {sc}% -> light {pn}% lightness ladder */")
    lines.append(channel_block("pitch", pitch, ladder))
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(channel_block("noise", noise, ladder))
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(channel_block("mod", mod, ladder))
    lines += ["\t\t\t}", "\t\t\t.beepboxEditor button, .beepboxEditor select {",
              "\t\t\t\tbox-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--input-box-outline);",
              "\t\t\t}", "\t\t\t`,", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)

Done. Palettes found in monkeytype source (`frontend/src/ts/constants/themes.ts`, via GitHub raw — themes now live in TS constants, not `static/themes.json`).

**Renamed:** `cod` → `cod salmon` (label "Cod Salmon"), `defaultTheme` updated. Old saves keep working:

`editor/ColorConfig.ts`
```ts
public static readonly themeAliases: { [oldName: string]: string } = { "cod": "cod salmon" };
public static resolveThemeName(name: string): string { ... }
```
`setTheme` resolves first; ThemePrompt resolves stored name so select preselects right.

**New themes** (ColorConfig lines 146–642, inserted before `"dark competition"`): `viridescent`, `solarized osaka`, `gruvbox dark`, `watermelon`. Each sets full var set — surfaces, scrollbars, track row bgs, tonic/fifth, oscilloscope, note-flash, disabled notes, `--comment-marker`, 8 pitch / 5 noise / 4 mod channel quads, limits.

**ThemePrompt:** new `Codbox Themes` optgroup after Default Themes.

Base colors (monkeytype):
| theme | bg | main | caret | text |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| viridescent | #2c3333 | #95d5b2 | #f0d3c9 | #e9f5db |
| solarized_osaka | #00141a | #859900 | #b58900 | #eee8d5 |
| gruvbox_dark | #282828 | #d79921 | #fabd2f | #ebdbb2 |
| watermelon | #1f4437 | #d6686f | #d6686f | #cdc6bc |

Channel colors not hand-typed — new tool generates them from a hue list + lightness ladder (dark theme convention: sec-channel 30% → prim-channel 66% → sec-note 46% → prim-note 80%):
- `tools/gen_codbox_themes.py` — regenerate blocks, splice before `"dark competition"`
- `tools/check_theme_contrast.py` — WCAG report. All new themes ≥3.3:1 on channel/note colors. Watermelon first pass failed (2.55:1 — dark melon reds sank into rind-green rows); fixed with lighter ladder 32/70/50/84 + darker row bgs.

`make check` green (all 3 tsconfigs). todo.md updated.

Notes:
- monkeytype spells it **viridescent** (no "i" after "virid") — kept their spelling.
- Section label "Codbox Themes"; Cod Salmon left in Default Themes. Say word if you want Cod Salmon moved into the Codbox group instead.
- Untested in browser. Weakest guesses needing eyeball: gruvbox `--tonic`/`--fifth-note` (dim warm fills), watermelon mute-button coral. Run `make dev`, cycle the Codbox group.

transcript.text:
Solarized Osaka rewired to be native + harsher.

**Surfaces — only real osaka/solarized colors now:**
```
--page-margin: #002b36          base03 frame
--editor-background: #00141a    osaka bg
--ui-widget-background: #00222b osaka sub-alt
--ui-widget-focus: #073642      base02
--text-selection: rgba(7,54,66,0.92)   base02 (solarized's own selection)
--secondary-text: #839496       base0 (was a smoothed #7c949b)
--playhead: rgba(238,232,213,0.8)       text, up from 0.65
--mute-button-normal: #b58900   caret · --mute-button-mod: #d33682 colorfulError
--disabled-note-*: #586e75 / #073642    base01 / base02
```
Track rows derive from base02 → osaka bg (`#03232c` / `#001a21`), noise rows nudged green, mod rows nudged violet.

**Channels = the solarized wheel itself**, accent hex verbatim as primary-channel + secondary-note:
```
1 #859900 green(main)  2 #2aa198 cyan(sub)   3 #268bd2 blue    4 #6c71c4 violet
5 #d33682 magenta      6 #dc322f red         7 #cb4b16 orange  8 #b58900 yellow(caret)
```
Only the two extremes are mixed: secondary-channel = accent 42% toward bg, primary-note = accent 50% toward base3. Noise = base00/base0/base1 + two base00 tints (base01 `#586e75` alone reads as 2.8:1 channel tab — dropped). Mod = violet/blue/cyan/magenta.

Generator gained an `accents` mode for that (`tools/gen_codbox_themes.py`), plus `--splice` so re-runs rewrite the region in place instead of me hand-cutting:
```
python3 tools/gen_codbox_themes.py --splice && python3 tools/check_theme_contrast.py "solarized osaka"
```
Osaka now: pitch channels min 3.47, notes min 7.0, noise 3.3, mod 3.15. `make check` green. Cod Salmon stays in Default Themes (never moved).
